name: @workspace/aef-domain-profiles
description: Alloy Embedding Fabric — versioned domain profiles for Lyte, Vessels, Terra, Aegis, PRISM Counsel, and Carlota Jo. Each profile declares chunking strategy, query and document prompt templates, default metadata filters, rerank toggle, top-k, score thresholds, privacy level, and retention rules. Ships a model registry with active-profile pointer, deprecation, and rollback semantics.
